Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.physics

Class PhysicsBody

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.physics.PhysicsObject
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.physics.PhysicsBody
Direct Known Subclasses:
ConvexPolyhedra, PhysicsBox, PhysicsPlane, PhysicsSphere
public abstract class PhysicsBody extends PhysicsObject
An abstract class inherited by all classes representing rigid bodies.

    • applyImpulse

      public void applyImpulse(org.jogamp.vecmath.Vector3f impulse, org.jogamp.vecmath.Vector3f point)
      Applies a Newtonian impulse at a given point to this body. The impulse (instant velocity change) is applied at the given point as if it was inside the body.
      Parameters:
      impulse - a vector giving the size and direction of the impulse.
      point - the point in world coordinates at which the impulse is applied.

    • getCollisionVelocity

      public org.jogamp.vecmath.Vector3f getCollisionVelocity(org.jogamp.vecmath.Vector3f point)
      Returns the compuond velocity of the body at a given point. Calculates a total velocity from the body's angular and linear velocities at the given point.
      Parameters:
      point - the point at which to meassure the compound velocity.
